cover_letter:
Dear Nestlé recruitment team,

I am writing to apply for the Nescafé Marketing Internship in Brussels, starting February 2027.

My background sits between marketing and the web. As a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto I write and optimise SEO content for client websites, publish and maintain pages and blog posts in WordPress, and report on results through Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. Alongside that I run my own freelance practice: I designed and built baverok.com and mirook.com, and for mirook.com I implemented structured data, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, then used iterative technical audits to raise its search-health score. Before that I worked as a front-end developer and supported SharePoint-based digital workplace projects for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo at KXP. That combination means I am comfortable on the content side and unafraid of the technical one — useful when localising international assets, running a content calendar, or adapting artwork and web content with several stakeholders in the loop.

What attracts me to this role is the scope: product launches, packaging, campaign activations, CRM newsletters and social content, all under one brand. I like keeping several projects moving at once, watching the details, and then checking the numbers to see whether the work actually did something. An internship in a fast-moving FMCG environment, with real ownership and a team to learn from, is exactly the next step I want.

Practical notes: I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, fluent in English and improving my Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+). If a CIP convention suits Nestlé better than a university agreement, I am glad to go that route.

Thank you for your time. I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can contribute to the Nescafé team.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
